description: Lists all of Platinumride's published travel guides (currently 13) in one response, with no pagination or filtering. Each entry has a title, cities, route slug and page URL. Pass a guide slug to get that guide's full text, sections and FAQs. Use it for questions about driving time, border documents and what to expect on the road. For prices and booking, use search_routes and get_route_details instead.

slug.description: Optional. Guide slug from the list, e.g. 'dubai-to-muscat-travel-guide'. Omit to list all guides. An unknown slug returns an error.

name: list_travel_guides
title: List travel guides
